title: One call between two agents, call-record/1 (DEC-0111)
description: Written by the callee's node for each call it answered or refused, and by the caller's for a call that got no answer. It names agents, a context, a capability, times, an outcome and a cost, never a person, an argument, an output or a token (DL-22), and never enters a usage report. An organization reads the records of its context in check-in records.callRecords while its acknowledged notice names agent calls. FAC-SEM-140. docs/specification/credentials.md#the-call-record.

callId.description: the call's id; caller and callee record one call under one id

traceId.description: links the calls of one task (W3C Trace Context)

parentCallId.description: the call this one was made for, when a callee calls on

code.description: the refusal or error code (DL-19 or the callee's own); absent exactly when completed

usd.description: what the callee spent on the call, decimal USD; null when unknown, never 0 for unknown

route.description: as a usage row's route (DEC-0110): a subscription's usd is an estimate
